sentences.text: The present petition has been filed under Section 438 CrPC seeking anticipatory bail in connection with FIR No.1213/2023 under Sections 376/323/342/506 IPC registered at PS Nihal Vihar.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner invites the attention of the Court to the FIR, to contend that the incident of rape is stated to be of 10.08.2023 but the FIR came to be registered only on 12.09.2023.

He further refers to the FIR wherein it has been mentioned that the alleged incident of 10.08.2023 was shared by the prosecutrix with her husband on 25.08.2023 but still the present FIR came to be registered belatedly only on 12.09.2023.
3.
He submits that there is no MLC of the petitioner conducted in the present case.
He further invites the attention of the Court to Annexure A-2, to contend that multiple payments have been made by the petitioner to the This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 17/11/2023 at 21:30:48 real brother of the prosecutrix, to financially help him.
He submits that the prosecutrix is an ex-colleague of the petitioner and they both were in friendly relationship.
He submits that the present FIR was registered only after the husband of the petitioner came to know of their relationship.
4. Notice in this petition was issued on 06.10.2023 and a direction was given to the State to file status report.
5. Status report dated 24.10.2023 has been filed and the same is on record.

6. A perusal of the status report, more particularly, para 6 thereof, shows that the petitioner was also in touch with the father of the prosecutrix and CDR of the mobile phone of the petitioner as well as prosecutrixs father have been referred to in the status report.
7. Having regard to the facts of the case, the stand taken by the petitioner cannot be outrightly rejected at this stage.

Accordingly, it is directed that in the event of petitioner being arrested, he shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing a Personal Bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- and one surety bond of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer/SHO/Investigating Officer concerned and further subject to the condition that he will join investigation as and when directed by the IO concerned.
8. The petition stands disposed of.
9. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
VIKAS MAHAJAN, J NOVEMBER 10, 2023 MK
